name: Neuendorf House
location: near Santanyi, Mallorca, Balearic Islands, Spain (AA lists Palma, Islas Baleares)

sources.what: AA article text (6,000 sq ft, five bedrooms, 110 m stepped path with parallel freestanding wall, slit into a roofless atrium with 9 m walls, 30 m pool, rooftop terrace, Santanyi lime render) and 14 photos by Clemente Vergara

Pawson project page: holiday house for a German art dealer in an almond grove, 1987-1989, with Claudio Silvestrin, team Crispin Osborne; photos only, no drawings
ArchEyes article: credits (structures Tietz & Partners, builder J. Salis), gallery photos (bathroom with round basin, bedroom with three windows, guest WC, tennis court) and the three drawings

accuracy.basis: Traced from the published ground and upper floor plans (ArchEyes, credited to Pawson + Silvestrin), which have no scale bar or printed dimensions: scaled from a standard element, the doubles tennis court drawn on the site plan (23.77 x 10.97 m = 214.5 x 97 px, 9.02 px/m), cross-checked by the 110 m approach path drawn as 11 equal modules (9.05 px/m) and the stated 12 m courtyard (drawn 11.5 m clear, 11.9 m between wall centres). Heights from the two unscaled site sections (proportions) and photos scaled by plan widths.
accuracy.notes: Re-traced 22 Oct 2026 from the drawings; replaces the photo-only model (accuracy D, 21 m square). The house is 18.9 m square (not 21 m); exterior walls drawn about 0.45 m, the ground-floor wall between the north wing and the courtyard about 0.85 m. Frame: +y up the archeyes plan, origin at the outer south-west corner of the house; true north is inferred (as before, from afternoon shadows) to point to plan -x, i.e. north_deg 90 = north lies 90 deg counter-clockwise from plan +y; the plan is not mirrored relative to the photos (slit near the west end of the approach facade, screen wall to the right of the pool facade, loggia to the left of the living room seen from the courtyard). Estimated: total height 7.45 m (the frontal pool-facade photo S2, scaled by the 18.9 m facade at 51.6 px/m, puts the parapet 7.39 m above the loggia floor; approach photo S3 gives about 7.6 m with a person for scale; the unscaled sections (8.3-9.3 m) and AA's 9 m are not used); first floor at 3.2 m (gallery parapet 4.15 m above the courtyard in photo S20); roof terrace at 6.4 m (gallery soffit about 6.0 m; photo S20 suggests 6.0-6.3 m) with a 1.05 m parapet; pool terrace -0.85 m; screen wall 3.4 m above the house floor; door heights; stair risers (18); path levels (0.4 m per module, from section S18) and the level top of the path wall at +1.2 m; tennis court floor -5.25 m with walls to -1.7 m (section S18). Slot windows of the pool facade taken from photo S2 where the plan shows none (bottoms 4.67 m above the loggia floor, sill 1.47 m above the first floor). Not modelled: the slot-window recess and its hood on the pool facade, skylights, the stair to the roof and to the lower level, a below-grade room the section shows under the pool surround, the lower basin past the pool end (plan x 55-61.5 m) and the walk beyond it, the short path to the tennis court, the lawn and the sloping ground. A lower level is likely: section S18 shows rooms below grade on the pool axis and an archeyes photo shows a sunken patio with a water spout, but no plan of it is published; it would explain why the drawn floors (about 290 m2 of rooms, 400 m2 gross) fall short of the stated 557 m2 and hold three bedrooms where the text says five. Unresolved: room functions are not labelled on the plan (taken from photos and fittings); the text's five bedrooms vs three drawn; the absolute height scale (about +-0.3 m). Pool head: the plan draws the pool outline from the facade line with a 0.55 m element at its head (water from about x 19.2 m); the model keeps two 0.45 m steps down from the loggia and the water from x 19.8 m, because photos S4 and S12 show two full-width steps and a coping before the water.

rooms.notes: Four of the nine squares left open (Pawson). Drawn about 11.5 m clear (text: 12 x 12 m). Slit in the south wall 4.1-4.76 m from the west corner (plan), full height; timber door at its foot (photo S3, 2.36 m). Walls 7.45 m above the courtyard floor: from the frontal pool-facade photo S2 (7.39 m) and photo S3 (about 7.6 m); the two unscaled sections give 8.3 and 9.3 m and AA says 9 m. Bench along the west wall as drawn (about 10.9 m).

rooms.notes: West end of the north wing, open to the kitchen; lit only by two folding-door openings to the courtyard (2.77 m wide in the plan, 2.84 m high from photo S20). The wall to the courtyard is drawn about 0.85 m thick. Function from photos (dining table, bench); the plan has no labels.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.notes: Galley of two drawn counters between the dining room and the stair, with the passage behind the stair to the bathroom. Kitchen function inferred from the counters and photo of the kitchen counter beside the dining table.

rooms.name: Stair
rooms.notes: U-stair with a semicircular winder turn at its north end and a spine wall between the flights (plan; photo S10). Risers estimated: 18 x 0.178 m to the first floor (6 straight, 6 winders, 6 straight). The flight on to the roof terrace and the flight down to a lower level (photo S10) are not modelled. Open to the first-floor landing; no room above the stairwell.

rooms.name: Hall
rooms.notes: Hall at the foot of the stair; its wall to the loggia is drawn 0.85 m thick up to x 16.05 and 0.44 m beyond, and an L-shaped wall stub stands in front of the WC door (drawn). Entered from the loggia through a 0.85 m door; links the kitchen, stair, guest WC and (via the kitchen passage) the bathroom.

rooms.name: Bathroom
rooms.notes: Bath and WC drawn; door from the passage behind the stair. Small square window in the east facade (photo S21: sill about 1.4 m).

rooms.name: Guest WC
rooms.notes: Long, 0.75 m wide WC strip along the pool facade (drawn; its wall to the loggia is 0.44 m, so the strip runs about 6.0 m clear), entered from the hall; tall slot window at its north end (plan and photo S21; archeyes guest-toilet photo).

rooms.notes: Middle square of the pool wing, open to the pool (5.2 m, the full clear width) and to the courtyard (2.77 m). Opening heights from photos (2.75 m pool side, 2.8 m courtyard side).

rooms.name: Living room

openings.name: Folding timber doors to the courtyard (2.77 m, drawn; height from photo)

rooms.notes: South square of the pool wing, lit only by its folding-door opening to the courtyard (photo S20 shows armchairs inside). Blank to the pool and the south.

rooms.name: Pool terrace
rooms.notes: Plinth along the pool facade, 8.0 m deep (plan) and 0.85 m below the house floor (two big steps up into the loggia; photo S4); benches along the facade either side of the loggia as drawn. The plinth's level is estimated from photos.

rooms.name: East court behind the screen wall
rooms.notes: Strip between the east facade and the freestanding screen wall at the plinth edge (plan). Its level is assumed to be the house floor (steps up from the pool terrace at its south end, photo S21).

rooms.name: Master bathroom and dressing room

fixtures.name: Built-in storage wall along the west wall (drawn solid, 0.89 m with the shell)

rooms.notes: The north wing's upper floor west of the stair: one long top-lit room with a freestanding partition and a closet unit (dressing area to the west) and the bathroom with a travertine counter and round pedestal basin (archeyes bathroom photo). Row of square windows in the east facade (plan; photo S21: about 0.45 m, sill 1.55 m). Includes the WC niche over the stair head (drawn WC, one east window): the plan draws it open to this room and closed to the north-east bedroom by a 0.2 m wall. The west wall is drawn 0.89 m thick here: modelled as the 0.45 m shell plus a full-height built-in storage wall 0.44 m deep (use uncertain).

rooms.name: Master bedroom
rooms.notes: North-east corner room entered from the corridor: three square windows in the east (top) facade and one slot window in the pool facade (plan; photo S21). The ArchEyes bedroom photo with three windows and a skylight shows bedroom 1, not this room. Skylight not modelled.

rooms.name: Landing and corridor
rooms.notes: Stair landing and the narrow top-lit corridor to the pool facade, with a small end window (plan; photo S13). Low balustrade over the up-flight assumed.

rooms.name: Open gallery over the courtyard
rooms.notes: Roofed gallery along the courtyard side of the pool wing, open to the courtyard above a solid parapet (plan; photos S5, S20); modelled as an indoor corridor so its walls split cleanly with the rooms it serves. Parapet top 4.15 m above the courtyard (photo S20), i.e. 0.95 m above this floor; tall glazed doors with timber shutters to the two south bedrooms.

rooms.name: Bathroom 2
rooms.notes: Bathroom off the landing, with a semicircular bath drawn against the gallery wall.

rooms.name: Bedroom 2

openings.name: Glazed door with timber shutters to the gallery

rooms.notes: Over the loggia; entered only from the gallery (plan, photo S20; the walls to both bathrooms are drawn solid); three slot windows in the pool-facade band (photo S2; not drawn in the plan).

rooms.name: Bathroom 1
rooms.notes: Ensuite to bedroom 1 only, reached through a 0.78 m passage between the bedroom's closets (plan); the 1.4 x 0.5 m recess in its wall to bedroom 2 opens to this bathroom, not to the bedroom. Window in the pool-facade band (photo S2).

The ArchEyes bedroom photo with three close-set windows, a skylight and closets on the north wall shows this room (skylight not modelled).

rooms.name: Roof terrace
rooms.notes: Rooftop terrace (AA) behind a parapet level with the courtyard walls (7.45 m). Roof level and parapet height estimated; access stair and skylights not modelled.
